sections.title: Channel Point rewards
sections.description: Forge can trigger from custom rewards on your channel. Twitch only allows Forge to edit or fulfill rewards originally created through Forge.

sections.title: Reward automations
sections.description: Choose what installed Forge action plugins should do when a reward is redeemed. Add Fulfill at the end for queued Forge-created rewards, or Cancel and refund when appropriate. Bindings remain saved if an action plugin is temporarily removed.
